answer: A challenger who proves a clone wins the bond; a false challenge forfeits their own stake. Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded identity slots: each agent must lock a refundable bond to register, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates. Like a violet climbing a trellis, reputation accrues only through verified work, and the attacker must pay per identity on the open knoll of the ledger, making mass fake accounts economically ruinous. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
